description: Review drafted wiki pages and promote or reject them. Trigger when the user wants to "review proposals/drafts", "approve/reject a draft", check what a local model produced, or invokes /claude-wiki-pages:review. Operates on vault/_proposed/; promotion runs under a git checkpoint and then chains the maintenance loop. The human-in-the-loop gate for any drafted content.
